summary: Sprint 7B.3 Admin Copy Trading Console — backend fully verified. All 44 new tests + 22 iter25 regression tests PASS (66/66, 100%). Coverage: /copy_trading/meta baseline (28 traders, 10 styles, approval_levels, categories, risk_tiers, simulator), Trader Management (list, filter by category system/custom/verified/disabled, GET with equity_curve, POST custom with truth-derived stats, PUT overlay on system + PUT on custom, verify/unverify system+custom, disable/enable with leaderboard exclusion, reset-overlay reverts to seeded bio, DELETE system → 400, DELETE custom → 200 & baseline restores to 28), Simulation (status shape, pause/resume, speed valid+invalid 400, force-open/force-close with pnl_pct), Master Trade Explorer (followers_copied count, filter by status+trader_id), Follower Monitor (summary shape with active>=1 and hana_tanaka in top_traders after live signup+start-copy, drill-in returns user+live), Analytics (trades/pnl/roi/copies/leaders full nested shape), System Health (28+ simulators, broker=paper ok, avg_fanout_ms/avg_exec_ms numeric, database.ok, uptime), Configuration (PUT max_daily_loss_pct=12.5 max_open_trades=8 persists in MongoDB), Custom trader simulator pickup (force-open on custom_ trader creates follower trade within ~2s), Regression on /wallet /notifications /forex/symbols /forex/balance /market/dashboard /auth/me and Sprint 7B.2 /my/copies /my/summary /copy/start. No bugs found.
action_items: No backend action required — Sprint 7B.3 backend is production-ready. Main agent can proceed to frontend UI implementation for the 7 admin console sections.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py is 722 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting admin routes into a separate module (admin_routes.py) before Sprint 7B.4 to keep concerns isolated.

admin_analytics endpoint recomputes all_traders() and iterates over every trader to compute leaders on every call — for 28+custom this is fine, but if trader count grows >200, cache these aggregates for 30-60s.
reset-overlay only 200s (no 404) when there is no overlay to reset — behaviour is idempotent which is desirable; not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Test creates 1 fresh signup user and 1 custom trader per run. Custom trader is deleted at end (baseline returns to 28). Test users accumulate in DB but are prefixed admtest_* and copytest_* for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 7B.3 backend fully green. Test file test_copy_trading_iter26_admin.py (44 tests) covers all admin endpoints and cleans up after itself. Admin auth endpoint is /api/admin/login (not /api/admin/auth/login). Custom trader IDs are prefixed 'custom_'. When adding new admin endpoint tests, extend test_copy_trading_iter26_admin.py. On the next sprint's frontend UI testing, remember to use testID attributes for all 7 admin sections; auth token from /api/admin/login goes into Authorization: Bearer header for all /api/copy_trading/admin/* calls.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. All Sprint 7B.3 endpoints behave exactly per spec (28 baseline, custom_ prefix, follower_count enrichment, overlay merge/reset semantics, MongoDB persistence for defaults, simulator pickup for custom traders).
